title: Bingkai Navy
summary: Dense back-office look: dark-navy frame around a light canvas, navy brand, Inter + Plus Jakarta Sans + Geist Mono, 14px base; a touch density (44px controls) for POS and kiosk screens of the same app.
when_to_use: Back-office and admin apps used for hours a day on desktop: ERP, inventory, finance, HR, internal tools.
Data-dense screens: tables, documents, forms with many fields.
Touch-first screens of such an app — POS on a tablet, attendance or visitor kiosk, queue display, kitchen screen — with the touch density (ui-core setDensity("touch")), not a separate preset.
when_not_to_use: Public or marketing pages and consumer apps: research their own direction.
